explanation: Honey is about four-fifths sugar dissolved in a little water, and all that sugar packs extra mass into every litre, so a litre jar of honey weighs about 1.4 kg.

claims.text: A litre of honey has a mass of about 1.4 kg.
A litre of water has a mass of about 1 kg.
Honey is about 80% sugar by weight.
